title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Provision of Emergency Maternal and Child Health services for Sudan crisis affected refugees and returnees project supported mothers and children with emergency maternal and child health services in Renk County, Upper Nile. The project provided returnees and refugees with essential life-saving health care management services, improved water, hygiene and sanitation facilities, essential life-saving nutrition services and health and nutrition awareness messages. The project targeted children pregnant women and lactating women. . OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Improved protection services and empowerment opportunities for the most vulnerable women and girls. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The Provision of Emergency Maternal and Child Health services for Sudan crisis affected refugees and returnees project provided essential and life-saving health, nutrition and WASH services to returnees and refugees in a Transit Centre in Renk County, Upper Nile, South Sudan. The project provided Anti Natal Care (ANC), immunisation services for children, improved WASH facilities and screening and referrals for acute malnutrition, reducing morbidity and mortality among refugees and returnees in the Transit Centre
